rationale: Stable v1.82.0 reports incomplete Zigbee diagnostic data without explaining it. This task improves that existing diagnostic behaviour with source-scoped, named reasons and preserved reported failed stages; route selection and scan behaviour stay unchanged.

summary.ru: В диагностике Zigbee добавлены конкретные причины неполноты данных отдельно для ZHA и топиков Zigbee2MQTT.
summary.en: Zigbee diagnostics now explain incomplete data separately for ZHA and Zigbee2MQTT topics.
